caption: "world labs" — 1,000+ searches today. AMD is buying Fei-Fei Li's AI lab.

Why: On September 28, AMD agreed to buy World Labs in an all-stock deal worth about $8.2 billion. World Labs builds AI that turns text, images or video into 3D worlds. Li, often called the "godmother of AI," becomes AMD's chief scientist. The deal should close by the end of 2026.
What most people don't know: Nvidia, AMD's main rival in AI chips, helped fund World Labs. Its venture arm backed the lab's first $230 million, and Nvidia joined its $1 billion round in February.
Very simply put: AMD is buying a lab its rival helped pay for.

slides.headline: AMD will buy Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for about *$8.2 billion*.
slides.sub: All in AMD stock. Announced September 28, expected to close by the end of 2026.

slides.headline: Li becomes AMD's *chief scientist*, reporting to CEO Lisa Su.

slides.headline: World Labs turns text and photos into explorable *3D worlds*.
slides.sub: It calls this “spatial intelligence”. Its first product, Marble, launched in November 2025.

slides.headline: It launched in 2024 with *$230 million*, at a $1 billion valuation.
slides.sub: It raised another $1 billion in February 2026.

slides.headline: Li built *ImageNet*: over 14 million hand-labeled images.
slides.sub: About 49,000 online workers in 167 countries helped label them.
